title: cyperus rotundus subsp. inconspicuus
intro: Cyperus rotundus subsp. inconspicuus, commonly known as Dwarf Papyrus or Small-flowered Nutgrass, is a subspecies of the Cyperus rotundus plant, a type of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic effects. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus rotundus subsp. inconspicuus include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as providing relief from digestive issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
